description: CLI tool using Typer with 'detect' and 'remove' commands. The 'remove' command supports --mode fast/full flag.
steps: Create src/synthid_tool/cli.py - Main CLI module using Typer. App with two commands: 'detect' and 'remove'.

Implement 'detect' command: accepts image path (positional arg), optional --codebook path, optional --output json/text format. Loads image, runs detector, prints results (confidence, is_watermarked, phase_match).

Implement 'remove' command: accepts input image path and output path (positional args), --mode flag (fast/full, default fast), --strength (for fast: gentle/moderate/aggressive, for full: final/nuke), --model (for full mode, default gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview), --codebook path. Runs the appropriate pipeline, saves output, prints summary (PSNR, stages applied, time taken).
Add a console entry point in pyproject.toml: [project.scripts] synthid = 'synthid_tool.cli:app'
Add rich/colorful output using Typer's built-in rich integration - show progress spinner during processing, colored confidence scores (green = not watermarked, red = watermarked)
Create tests/test_cli.py - Test CLI invocations using typer.testing.CliRunner: test 'synthid detect --help', test 'synthid remove --help', test detect on a dummy image, test remove on a dummy image.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'synthid --help' shows the two available commands: detect and remove
Running 'synthid detect <image_path>' prints detection results to stdout
Running 'synthid remove <input> <output> --mode fast' creates an output image file
Running 'synthid remove <input> <output> --mode full' creates an output image file using the 7-stage V4 pipeline
